200.description: The cookie is cleared; the expiry is in the past

403.description: Not allowed: API tokens are refused here, use a signed-in session. The answer is an error with the message `API tokens cannot sign out a session`.

description:
Ends this session and clears the session cookie, so a copy of the cookie stops working too. It answers 200 even when no valid session was sent; a request with an API token is refused with 403.

Needs: a signed-in session (API tokens are refused)
